class.name: FidelityFXUpscaler
class.brief_description: Optional external FidelityFX Vulkan runtime with source FSR3 fallback.
class.description: Loads a compatible external public-API Vulkan provider from [member library_path]. The library must be an external native file, outside the PCK. Native Linux cannot load Windows DLLs. When enabled, [member allow_source_fallback] uses the built-in source implementation if the provider is unavailable. This class does not guarantee compatibility with FSR4 or driver overrides.

method.name: get_active_backend
method.description: Returns the active external runtime, source fallback, or unavailable status.

method.name: get_active_version
method.description: Returns the active provider version, or 3.1.6 when source fallback is active.

method.name: get_available_versions
method.description: Returns provider names reported by the loaded runtime. It is empty before initialization or after a loading failure.

method.name: get_binary_error
method.description: Returns the latest external runtime loading, selection or dispatch error. This remains available when source fallback is active.

method.name: get_binary_failure_count
method.description: Returns failures reported while dispatching through the external runtime.

members.member: Use built-in source FSR 3.1.6 when the external Vulkan provider is unavailable or fails.
Path to an external native public-API Vulkan runtime. Files packed inside the PCK cannot be loaded as native libraries.
Exact provider name to select from the runtime version query. An empty string lets the runtime choose.
